name: Cloud_Computing_Original
description:
Data Description:
	

Both system metrics (json format) and log data (json format) were collected from Cloud Computing Platform with hundreds of system entities invovled. Six different types of real faults (including cryptojacking, silent pod degradation fault, malware attack, mistakes made by GitOps, configuration change failure, and bug infection) were simulated.

evaluation_method: F1 (precision/recall) / accuracy for classification of fault types
reputation: Niche research dataset hosted on Hugging Face used in root-cause analysis and log-based anomaly detection studies; moderate adoption within that community.
